sor_no.description: the order this line belongs to (Satellite's export: order_id, as its order's order_no)

line_no.description: the line's number in the order (Satellite's export: line_no)

item_code.description: SAMB's material code (the Faktur Penjualan's Kode) (Satellite's export: item_code)

uom.description: the unit it was ordered in: CAR, PCS, … (Satellite's export: ordered_uom_id)

pcs_per_uom.description: pieces in one unit (Satellite's export: conversion_factor)

qty_uom.description: the quantity ordered, in units (Satellite's export: ordered_qty)

qty_pcs.description: the quantity ordered, in pieces (Satellite's export: ordered_base_qty)

price_uom.description: the price of one unit (Satellite's export: price_list_amount)

price_pcs.description: the price of one piece (the Faktur Penjualan's Harga) (Satellite's export: base_price_list_amount)

discounts.description: each discount given: {kind: {type, value, amount}}, kinds reg, dc, b2b, dmg, new, go, special, lsb, promo, additional (Satellite's export: disc_<kind>_type, disc_<kind>_value, disc_<kind>_amount)

gross.description: the amount before discounts (Satellite's export: subtotal_amount)

line_amount.description: the net amount (the Faktur Penjualan's Jumlah) (Satellite's export: total_amount)

vat.description: PPN on the line (Satellite's export: vat_amount)

invoice_amount.description: the invoiced net amount (Satellite's export: invoice_nett_amount)

cgr_qty.description: received, in pieces (the goods receipt) (Satellite's export: cgr_base_qty)

rejected_qty.description: rejected by the store (tolakan), in pieces (Satellite's export: cgr_rejected_base_qty)

reject_reason.description: why the store rejected it (Satellite's export: cgr_reject_reason)
